record_scope_reconstruction: The announced April 17 election suspension applies only to PLBN Skouw gate until 14:00 WIT. Urgent and sick travellers could cross; no full-day, total or frontier-wide interpretation.

source_checks.finding: Jayapura border official announces PLBN Skouw gate closure until 14:00 WIT with urgent/medical exceptions.

sites.name: Skouw–Wutung crossing area

sites.precision: Crossing-area reference; approximate to 300 m; not an exact historical barrier footprint.
sites.evidence_note: Mapped Papua Niugini customs/border-control node paired with Indonesian customs node on the same road. Antara locates the international crossing in Skouw District, Jayapura; The National names counterpart Wutung, West Sepik.
